detail.longDescription: I have a HTML file that I want to use as a interface for my projects, and I want to know if its possible to execute or open a python file from HTML or Javascript in 2026. The python file is in the same folder as the HTML and there is nothing I need to pass to the python file, I've tried to look at possible solutions but they all pertain to running the python in the browser or passing data to and from it which is not something I need. I do not want to use nodejs or any other external software. I just need to run the file.
